CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty');CTX='';if printf '%s
' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|][[:space:]]*)([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=[^[:space:]]*[[:space:]]+)*(env[[:space:]]+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=[^[:space:]]*[[:space:]]+)*)?gh pr create' && ! printf '%s
' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])--help([[:space:]]|$)'; then CTX='A PR was just created. Project rule: run /codex-review (cross-vendor Codex review of this branch) now, triage its findings, and record the verdict in the PR before handing it over for merge.'; fi;if printf '%s
' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|][[:space:]]*)git push'; then CTX="$CTX${CTX:+ }A git push just ran. Before treating this work as done: check the CI result for the pushed commit (gh run watch --exit-status <run-id>, or gh pr checks <pr> --watch) and report the outcome. If CI is red, investigate and fix before moving on."; elif printf '%s
' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|][[:space:]]*)git commit'; then CTX="$CTX${CTX:+ }A git commit just ran. hooks.command:
CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_-])git([^a-zA-Z0-9_-]|$)' || exit 0; printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_-])commit([^a-zA-Z0-9_-]|$)' || exit 0; case "$CMD" in *'[red]'*) exit 0 ;; esac; DIR="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; [ -n "$DIR" ] || { echo 'Commit gate cannot locate the repository (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR unset and not inside a work tree) — blocking rather than passing unchecked.' >&2; exit 2; }; ENG="$DIR/Packages/EmbroideryEngine"; if [ -d "$ENG" ]; then OUT=$(cd "$ENG" && swift test 2>&1) || { echo 'Engine tests are red — commit blocked. Never commit failing engine tests (fix or finish the green phase first). A deliberate TDD red-phase commit is allowed with a [red] marker in the commit message.' >&2; echo "$OUT" | tail -30 >&2; exit 2; }; fi; PROJ="$DIR/catrobat_embroidery_ios/catrobat_embroidery_ios.xcodeproj"; APPST=$(git -C "$DIR" status --porcelain -- catrobat_embroidery_ios/ 2>&1) || { echo 'Cannot read the working tree state under catrobat_embroidery_ios/ (git status failed) — blocking rather than passing unchecked, since an unreadable tree is indistinguishable from a clean one.' >&2; printf '%s
' "$APPST" | tail -5 >&2; exit 2; }; if [ -d "$PROJ" ] && [ -n "$APPST" ]; then command -v xcodebuild >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'The working tree has changes under catrobat_embroidery_ios/ but xcodebuild is not on PATH, so the app cannot be compile-checked — blocking rather than passing unchecked (ADR-023). Install Xcode and its command line tools, or mark a deliberate red-phase commit with [red] in the message.' >&2; exit 2; }; DD="$HOME/Library/Caches/catty-embroidery-precommit-$(printf '%s' "$DIR" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1)"; OUT=$(xcodebuild build-for-testing -project "$PROJ" -scheme catrobat_embroidery_ios -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath "$DD" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet 2>&1) || { echo 'App target does not compile — commit blocked. The gate checks the whole working tree under catrobat_embroidery_ios/, not just the staged part, because no reliable way exists to tell from a command string which paths a commit will include. Finish the app change, stash it, or mark a deliberate red-phase commit with [red].' >&2; ERRS=$(printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -E 'error:' | head -20); [ -n "$ERRS" ] || ERRS=$(printf '%s
' "$OUT" | tail -20); printf '%s
' "$ERRS" >&2; exit 2; }; fi
hooks.statusMessage: engine test + app compile gate (git commit)
